Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class ReviewService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.ReviewService
public class ReviewService extends Object
Seller-review lifecycle service backed by the MySQL reviews and deals tables.

Validates completed-deal eligibility, writes reviews, seller replies, moderation flags, and hidden/unhidden state while notifying affected users in the same transaction.

  • Method Details

    • getSellerReviews

      public List<Review> getSellerReviews(User seller) throws SQLException
      Returns the signed-in seller's visible reviews, newest first.

      Reviews hidden by an administrator are excluded. The lookup runs on its own connection and commits before returning.

      Parameters:
      seller - the signed-in seller
      Returns:
      the seller's visible reviews
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the stored account is missing, inactive, or not a seller
      SQLException - if the account or review query fails

    • getPublicProfile

      public ReviewService.SellerProfile getPublicProfile(String username) throws SQLException
      Returns the public profile of a seller together with their visible reviews.

      No signed-in account is required. Hidden reviews are excluded, and only public fields (name, username, bio, preferred meet-up) are exposed.

      Parameters:
      username - the seller's username
      Returns:
      the public seller profile and visible reviews
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no seller has that username
      SQLException - if the account or review query fails

    • submitReview

      public void submitReview(User buyer, String dealId, int rating, String comment) throws SQLException
      Saves one review for a finished deal the buyer participated in.

      The comment is stripped and must contain 1 to 2,000 characters, and the rating must be from 1 to 5. Inside one transaction the buyer is re-read and must be active, the deal is locked, and it must belong to that buyer and be Completed or Returned. A deal can be reviewed only once, and a deal whose seller account was deleted cannot be reviewed. The review and the seller's "New Seller Review" notification commit together.

      Parameters:
      buyer - the signed-in buyer
      dealId - the finished deal identifier
      rating - the rating from 1 to 5
      comment - the review text
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the comment, rating, or deal id is invalid, the buyer is not active, the deal is not the buyer's finished deal, the deal was already reviewed, or the seller account was deleted
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • reply

      public void reply(User seller, String reviewId, String reply) throws SQLException
      Adds the seller's single reply to one of their visible reviews.

      The review must belong to the signed-in active seller, must not be hidden, and must not already have a reply. The reply and the buyer's "Seller Replied to Your Review" notification commit together.

      Parameters:
      seller - the signed-in seller
      reviewId - the review identifier
      reply - the reply text
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the reply text or review id is invalid, the seller is not active, the review is unavailable or hidden, the seller already replied, or the buyer account no longer exists
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • flag

      public void flag(User seller, String reviewId) throws SQLException
      Flags one of the seller's visible reviews for administrator moderation.

      Flagging an already-flagged review is a no-op. The update and the notification to every active admin commit together.

      Parameters:
      seller - the signed-in seller
      reviewId - the review identifier
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the review id is invalid, the seller is not active, or the review is missing, hidden, or not owned by the seller
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • setHidden

      public void setHidden(User admin, String reviewId, boolean hidden) throws SQLException
      Sets an administrator-controlled hidden state for a review.

      The acting account must be an active admin. Setting the state the review already has is a no-op. Hiding notifies the buyer and, when present, the seller in the same transaction; unhiding sends no notification.

      Parameters:
      admin - the acting administrator
      reviewId - the review identifier
      hidden - true to hide the review from public view, false to restore it
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the admin is not active or the review no longer exists
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back
